newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rupiah weakens on ample liquidity.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rupiah weakens on ample liquidity.

text.p: The Indonesian rupiah weakened against the dollar in volatile early trading on Thursday on the back of excess rupiah supply, dealers said.
But some foreign bank dealers said there could be a light spillover from early turbulence in the Thai currency market.
The Thai central bank categorically denied rumours in the foreign exchange market that the baht might be devalued.
"I don't think it's the spillover from Thailand because dollar buyers are mainly from Jakarta centre," one dealer in Singapore said, which was confirmed by Jakarta dealers.
One local bank dealer said operators were seen moving into dollars following excess rupiah supply domestically.
Dealers said ample liquidity pushed short-term swaps down, driving interest rates in the money market to follow.
Overnight swaps fell to 0.10/0.15 from 0.25/0.35 points and three-day tom/next swaps to 0.7/0.8 from 1.00/1.15.
"The market this morning is mainly liquidity-driven. There seems to be some fresh government transfers for civil servants' 13th month salaries," another local bank dealer said.
The payment was linked to the upcoming Eid al-Fitr celebration on February 9 and 10.
Overnight rupiah was last traded at 7.5/8.0 percent.
Dealers said sentiment on the dollar appeared to be bullish at present, triggering some operators to go long on dollars.
The local bank dealer said declining swaps trend might encourage some players to go long as the dollar downside was limited by the central bank intervention band.
Dealers said earlier diminishing speculation for a band widening could be supportive for long positions, but the market needed relatively stable short-term swap rates.
Spot rupiah was at 2,373.25/74.00 at 0315 GMT, compared with an opening of 2,371.25/71.75.
Tomorrow and today rupiah were at 2,372.75/73.25 and 2,372.75/73.25, respectively.
The local bank dealer said, however, the central bank fixing policy needed to be watched as it had depreciated the rupiah by only one point so far against four points last week.
Bank Indonesia kept its intervention band at 2,368.0/2.560 and the conversion band at 2,368/2,416 on Wednesday.
One-month swaps were at 11.25/11.75, two at 21.00/22.50, three at 33.25/34.25 and six at 71.00/72.00 points.
